title: Household of God
definition: The Household of God describes the Church as God's family, built on apostolic truth with Christ as the cornerstone.
summary: The Household of God portrays the Church as God's family, where believers live as brothers and sisters under the Father.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the cornerstone who holds God's household together.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The household of God describes the church as God's family and dwelling place. Scripture teaches that believers are no longer strangers but members of a spiritual household built on Christ.

This image emphasizes belonging, order, care, responsibility, and shared life. In God's household, people are not valued by worldly status but by grace and adoption.

Jesus is the cornerstone of the household. The family of God stands because He is the foundation and the One who brings people near.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many come from broken families, unsafe homes, or deep rejection. The household of God offers a redeemed picture of belonging, while also calling the church to behave like God's family with holiness and care.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Treat the church as family without pretending it is perfect. Welcome the lonely, honor spiritual fathers and mothers, protect the vulnerable, and build life around Christ the cornerstone.
